biggest_catch: The referral must be presented at account opening and you cannot be primary or joint on your friend's new account — plus your friend must keep their account open with at least a $50 balance for 60 days before THEY get their $25 (your $25 comes within 10 days of opening).
catches: Referring member cannot be primary or joint on the new member account.
Friend must open the new account with a balance of at least $50 and present the signed referral card.
Referrer's $25 is credited within 10 days of the new account opening.
Friend's $25 is credited after 60 days only if the minimum $50 balance is maintained.
FFCCU employees and the member they refer are not eligible for the bonus.
Reward reported on IRS Form 1099-INT for both members.
Rates, terms, and promotions subject to change.
Membership open to those who live, work, worship, or attend school in Cuyahoga, Geauga, Lake, Lorain, Medina, Portage, and Summit Counties (Ohio); subject to membership approval.

steps: Get a Member Referral Card at any FFCCU branch or download one; sign it so the credit union knows who referred.
Give the referral card to a friend, colleague, or family member.
Your friend brings the signed card to any FFCCU branch and opens a new account with at least a $50 balance (you cannot be primary or joint on the account).
You receive $25 within 10 days of your friend's account opening; your friend receives $25 after 60 days if the $50 minimum balance is maintained.
timing: Referrer's $25 credited within 10 days of the friend's account opening.
